more of the same - remnant 1 and 2 are really good games but they kind of the same, not really that much has changed. Sadly Remnant 2 trys to be some kind of Zelda game, but jumping and key puzzels and of cuz a "Paraglider" like in breath of the wild -  you can now climb and jump - witch is needed for the many puzzels. But the game really falls apart in the co-op multiplayer - Think of a door that only opens if the door behind you is closed - now try to do this "puzzel" with 2 randoms  - 10x in a mace. And the elevators that are so small and start moving as soon as you step on them. Wow - now we all have to wait till that thing goes down again and we can move up one by one. Remnant 1 was simple but fun, this game  does not know what it is. Dark souls? Helldivers? Zelda? yeah abit of everything - this games "flow" or "game-loop" is nearly not a thing. And this Map, you will spend 50% of your time looking at a low poly map, just to find out where to go next. Sounds bad, but all the small things, the constant glimbung, one shot kills form bosses, the elevators and climbing, the bad map layout, the cringy story, and yeah the game is really buggy conection lost - crashes on loading screens. Ah, and the best thing, if you play co-op and the other person does not "talk" to the NPC you have to Alt+F4 your game, cuz some random can controll your progress in a game you payed for and you have to go AFK for 15min so the troll will leave your game - CO-OP is broken
